status: Early public version; reviewed IBN results and evolving unbroken-session estimates.
historicalForecasts: Unavailable without suitable user-supplied learning history.
dataStorage: Local SQLite in the browser; no journal synchronization.
changes: Reviewed final daily highs and lows can establish IBN without a separate path-complete checkbox.
Before an IB edge break, compatible historical timing paths can update the outlook as an unbroken session approaches close.
Without compatible timing history, the estimate is labeled as a full-session baseline. No historical data is included.
Live outlooks can be saved without an original 15R forecast, and closing cards retain the latest saved RTH estimate.
Past forecasts are preserved. The model remains experimental; the full multi-day opening sequence is not modeled.
